what_this_is: own-history chronological backtest of the product's forecasting methods on real public retail series
what_this_is_not: evidence about price, marketing or customer scores

source.description: Indian local-store POS register, Jan-Mar 2025, units = sum of quantity per day (weighed items are fractional)
source.provenance: public Kaggle upload, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, authenticity inferred, uploader gives no store name

series.metric_guidance: WAPE and MAE are both meaningful

interval.method: empirical 80% quantile of the selection origins' absolute errors per horizon step (non-decreasing in the step)
interval.width_note: full width before clipping the lower bound at zero
interval.limitation: holdout points come from a handful of overlapping origins and are strongly dependent: the coverage figure is an approximate check, not a statistical guarantee

comparison_on_holdout.note: ratio < 1 means the selected method had a lower holdout MAE than that reference

horizons.statement: 7-day horizon: 'trailing_mean_28' (business specific baseline) is the baseline and had a lower holdout MAE than the naive last-value forecast; holdout MAE 576.35 units/day; over-forecast by 0.7% of actual units on the holdout; 80% band covered 71% of 14 dependent held-out points.
